correctness.rationale: Exact inverse of Hardy-block map, normalized kernel and Q/F identities reconstructed. PSD of two explicit 2×2 coefficient matrices, Schur positivity for geometric kernel series and nonvanishing K prove complete Pick for every asserted parameter. Exact defect and P principal-minor calculations prove rank two, expansivity and the if-and-only-if logarithmic-concavity threshold. SymPy checker verifies all symbolic identities and a strict interior rational example. No finite tests stand in for universal PSD argument.

value.rationale: The paper leaves an explicitly motivated logical distinction between kernel complete Pick and shift log-concavity. A whole open range, not a selected finite example, of nonradial rank-two-defect expansive shifts shows complete Pick survives the exact failure boundary; explicit rational certificate and exact boundary quantify the phenomenon. The assertion does not pretend to solve the general classification or exact Pick threshold.
